name: AppLayout
need: Both the main app (shell/AppShell) and another app (organisms/AppShell) hand-roll the SAME application shell: a grid of a sticky full-height nav column + a scrolling main, plus a mobile drawer + backdrop. It is duplicated per app and coupled to each app's SidebarProvider/router. A routing-agnostic AppLayout with a `nav` slot removes the duplication so any app composes <AppLayout nav={<SideNav/>}>...</AppLayout>.

consideredAlternatives.whyNot: Coupled to SidebarProvider, react-router useLocation, and a domain RecordingPill; not reusable.
Generic flex/grid primitives; no sticky full-height nav column + mobile drawer/backdrop semantics.

proposedApi.nav: ReactNode  // the navigation rail, e.g. a <SideNav/>
proposedApi.onNavClose: () => void  // mobile: backdrop / nav click closes

decidedBy: user (live, during the one app build)
